prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：CET6_Essay 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT20 (六级写作（CET-6）满分范文：科研评价体系中抵制数据造假与强化可复现性治理)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP33 -> BP35 -> BP37`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: That's all for my presentation. Thank you for listening. Do you have any questions? (When asked a hard question): Well, maybe we didn't test that, I think maybe it can work in the future.
structural_constraints: S1 [凝练核心带走信息 Core Take-Home Message]：To wrap up, if there is one takeaway from our work today, it is that [One-Sentence Core Principle].
S2 [成果三点速览 Rapid Recap]：By combining [A] and [B], [Model] delivers [Metric 1], [Metric 2], and [Open-Source/Practical Asset].
S3 [Q&A 礼貌接招与结论前置 Q&A Direct Answer]：(For Q&A) That is a great question regarding [Topic]—the short answer is [Direct Conclusion].
S4 [Q&A 展开与诚实边界 Q&A Elaboration]：In our current experiments, we observed [Empirical Fact], and extending this to [Questioner's Scenario] can be handled by [Concrete Mechanism].
target_defects_to_fix: 过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: 顶会 Author Rebuttal 置顶总括段（Official Global Response）
domain_context: 多模态灵巧操作与力触觉闭环反馈
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写 ICLR / NeurIPS / ICML / CVPR 审稿回复（Rebuttal）最顶部的致全体审稿人总括段（Global Response）：在 150 词内用最提气的语气感谢审稿人肯定，并一眼亮出我们在 Rebuttal 期间赶做出的所有硬核新增实验。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP45` 与全文样板 `FT20` 的后半部分（`BP39 -> BP40`），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: Our model is very fast and uses little memory. It only takes 4.2 ms to run, so it can be used in real-time applications easily.
structural_constraints: S1 [致谢并提炼审稿人共同好评 Gratitude & Shared Praise]：We thank all reviewers for their constructive feedback and for recognizing our work's [Quote Reviewer 1 Praise] (R1), [Quote Reviewer 2 Praise] (R2), and [Quote Reviewer 3 Praise] (R3).

S2 [概览新增实证工作 Overview of New Experiments]：In response to your valuable suggestions, we have conducted [N] sets of new experiments and theoretical analyses, summarized below and highlighted in blue in the revised PDF:

S3 [分条列出硬核新增实验 Bullet Summary of Additions]：(1) Added comparisons against recent baselines [A, B] on [Dataset] (Table R1, addressing R1, R3); (2) Evaluated real-world robustness under [Harsh Condition] (Appendix D, R2); (3) Provided wall-clock latency and memory profiling across sequence lengths up to $L=4,096$ (Appendix E, R3).
S4 [诚挚收束 Closing Courtesies]：We address each specific question in the individual responses below and welcome any further discussion.
target_defects_to_fix: 重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例
